Regency Alliance Insurance Plc will consider its unaudited third-quarter financial results on 28 October, 2026, as the insurer maintains restrictions on share trading by insiders ahead of the earnings release.
The company disclosed this in a notice dated October 13 and filed in compliance with the Nigerian Exchange Limited listing rules.
According to the notice, the board meeting will consider and approve the company’s unaudited financial statements for the third quarter ended 30 September, 2026.
The closed period for trading in the company’s shares began on 1 October and will remain in force until 24 hours after the financial statements are filed through the NGX Issuers’ Portal and released to the market.
During the period, insiders and persons closely associated with them are prohibited from dealing directly or indirectly in the company’s shares.
The restriction is intended to prevent trading based on material, non-public information ahead of the release of the insurer’s financial performance.
Investors will be watching the forthcoming results for indications of the company’s earnings performance, revenue growth and underwriting position in the third quarter.
